roles.name: wolf
roles.description: Wakes at night and eliminates one villager.

roles.name: seer
roles.description: Wakes at night and checks one player's identity.

roles.name: witch
roles.description: Has one save potion and one kill potion. Can use each once per game at night.

roles.name: hunter
roles.description: When eliminated, may shoot one player.

roles.name: guard
roles.description: Protects one player each night. Cannot protect the same player two nights in a row.

roles.name: villager
roles.description: Ordinary villager with no special abilities.

phases.name: night
phases.description: Werewolves, seer, and witch act secretly.

phases.name: day_discussion
phases.description: Players discuss and debate who might be a werewolf.

phases.name: day_vote
phases.description: Players vote to eliminate one suspected werewolf.

win_conditions.description: Werewolves win when the number of surviving wolves equals the number of surviving villagers.
Villagers win when all werewolves are eliminated.
